identity.title: Pocket Monsters Special Ruby Sapphire volume 1

leadText:
(Japanese: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL ルビー・サファイア 1 Ruby Sapphire volume 1) is the first volume of an omnibus compilation of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

This volume is released under Shogakukan's "My First Series" (マイファーストシリーズ) brand, which are bargain-priced volumes sold only in Japanese convenience stores. It has no connection to the discontinued 2011 omnibus release of the .

==Major events==

Ruby meets Professor Birch.

Mr. Stone gives Sapphire a letter for .
